# Making a pull request

## Description
Provide an accuate and clear description of the changes made and why they were nessesary.

## Related Issue
Fixes # (issue number)

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug Fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Breaking Change
- [ ] Documentation Update

## How did you test it?
Describe the tests you did here
- [ ] Unit test
- [ ] Integration Test
- [ ] Manual Varification

## Checklist

- [ ] My code and documentation follow the guidelines of PRISM
- [ ] I have performed my own review
- [ ] I have commented and documented code
- [ ] My changes do not break or rid of the original documentation
